scenarios.title: aaIsQuiet: two runs of the same provider in the same window are not a regression
largeDriftIsCaught: a 30 point drop in pass rate is reported, not shrugged off
tinyDriftIsNotOverclaimed: a 2 point drop at n=10 is not reported as a confirmed regression
latencyNeverGates: a doubled latency with unchanged quality does not fail a build
repeatedLooksDoNotManufactureAlarms: a watch of pure noise does not fire, however long it runs
theWatcherStillFires: a real sustained drop does alarm the watcher
oneReplicateIsInconclusive: a single draw per case cannot separate drift from noise
differentCorporaAreNotComparable: two runs of different corpora are refused, not diffed
confirmationIsRequired: one crossing is suspected, only a reproduction is confirmed
identityChangeIsReportedWithoutAPValue: a changed resolved model is a fact, not a statistic
spentSensitivityIsReported: a watch that has gone blind says so instead of staying quiet
metadataDriftIsNotQualityDrift: a changed endpoint is reported, and is not a regression
anOutageIsNotAQuietRun: an arm where every call failed is not a report that nothing moved

mutants.description: compares point estimates with no null model: any non-zero difference is a regression
never reports drift: passes every honesty property vacuously and is useless
reports drift on everything, which is the same as reporting nothing
gates CI on a difference of mean latency, over a distribution with a fat tail
runs a fixed-alpha test on every watch round, so repeated looks manufacture alarms
treats a single threshold crossing as a confirmed regression and fails the build
compares any two runs, including runs of different corpora
returns a confident verdict from one draw per case, where no noise estimate exists
reports a healthy wealth while it has quietly gone blind, so nobody re-baselines
reports a collection that failed as a collection that found nothing, at exit 0, forever
fails a build on a metadata change, which carries no p-value and is not behaviour
